sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Serotonin EC50 = 5.3 ± 0.04 µM (identical to wild-type); average agonist-evoked current density 393.1 ± 40.2 pA/pF in whole-cell patch-clamp; robust surface expression confirmed by [3H]BRL-43694 binding (60 pmol/mg protein). Tagged receptor declared functionally indistinguishable from wild-type.
sites.rationale: All six ledger lines from PMC2778300 converge on a C-terminal extension of the full-length mouse 5-HT3A receptor. The human receptor's C-terminus (residue 478, A) is within the short extracellular stub (476–478) that follows TM4 (ends at 475), placing the junction 3 residues from the TM boundary and satisfying the ≥3-residue constraint. L8 (PMC10179570) independently reports c-Myc/HA tags at the C-terminus of 5HT3A, further corroborating this position. Because the papers name only 'carboxyl terminus' without a specific residue, position_evidence is topology_derived: the C-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus available for a terminal_c tag, leaving no ambiguity about the junction. Mouse 5-HT3A receptor with a C-terminal alphaBgTx-pharmatope tag (plus a GN-repeat linker and a second pharmatope copy in the extended construct) stably expressed in HEK-293 cells; the tag is appended after the last coding residue of the full-length, membrane-anchored receptor.

sources.claim: A HEK-293 cell line that stably expresses mouse 5-HT(3A)Rs containing a C-terminal extension that confers high-affinity binding of alpha-bungarotoxin (alphaBgTx) was established (alphaBgTx-5-HT(3A)Rs) and used to purify alphaBgTx-5-HT(3A)Rs in a lipid environment for use in structural studies using photoaffinity labeling. alphaBgTx-5-HT(3A)Rs were expressed robustly (60 pmol of [(3)H]BRL-43694 binding sites (approximately 3 microg of receptor) per milligram of protein) and displayed the same functional properties as wild-type receptors (serotonin EC(50) = 5.3 +/- 0.04 microM).

literature_notes: L8 also reports c-Myc and HA tags at the C-terminus of 5HT3A (same junction as L1–L6); this is the same site, not a second distinct site, so it is not listed separately but strengthens confidence. The mCherry insertion at G395–G396 (mouse numbering, L7/L8) is in the intracellular TM3–TM4 loop (human topology: 322–455) and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports an insertion in the large N-terminal extracellular domain (residues 24–241) or in ECL1 (293–302) of the full-length membrane-anchored receptor; those regions are therefore not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: mCherry fluorescent protein inserted between TM3 and TM4 at G395–G396 (mouse 5HT3A numbering); this junction lies within the large intracellular loop (human topology 322–455) and is not accessible on the extracellular face.
